Win in [[the Jade Quarry]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Win 3 PvP battles in Jade Quarry.
* *BONUS* Win 5 PvP battles in Jade Quarry.
* *BONUS* Win 9 PvP battles in Jade Quarry.
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 5,000 [[Imperial faction|Imperial Faction]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 15 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 60 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
{{section-stub}}
See [[The Jade Quarry]] for general mechanics and tips on strategy.

For 3 wins, you earn 5 coins per win; for 5 wins, 9 coins/win; and for 9 wins, 11 2/3 coins/win. 
*To maximize the faction yield, turn the quest in after 3 wins.
*For maximum Zaishen Coin efficiency, turn in the quest after 9 wins.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
;Zaishen Combat
:''"The precious jade resources in Jade Quarry have captured [[Balthazar]]'s attention. To win his favor, return to [[Zehnchu]] with at least 3 victories."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I can do that!
| decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
| ask = More competitors needed to prove their mettle in combat. Travel to the battlegrounds if you have what it takes to triumph.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Trivia==
*This quest was first offered on 26 April 2009.
*The Jade Quarry began awarding Imperial faction instead of [[Kurzick faction|Kurzick]] or [[Luxon faction]] after the [[Feedback:Game updates/20110602|June 2, 2011 update]]; however, this quest did not switch to awarding Imperial faction until after the [[Feedback:Game updates/20110609|June 9, 2011 update]].
